title: Base-linear Leray comparison for acyclic direct image
statement: For arbitrary scheme maps p:Y -> X and f:X -> T [def-pc-scheme], injective resolutions of Y.Modules, and module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with all positive R^q p_*F zero, there is for each q a Gamma(T,O)-linear equivalence H^q(X,p_*F) = H^q(Y,F) [pqf-def-cohomology], where the actions are restricted along f.appTop and (p followed by f).appTop respectively.

source.place: Tag 01F4 (1), Lemma 20.13.6; naturality in coefficients in Tag 01EY

proof.text: Obtain the additive Leray equivalence and its compatibility with every coefficient endomorphism from the additive comparison theorem. Restrict the two existing cohomology module structures along f.appTop and (p followed by f).appTop.

For a global section r of T, pushforward_map_smulHom identifies multiplication by f.appTop(r) on p_*F with the pushforward of multiplication by p.appTop(f.appTop(r)) on F. Apply coefficient naturality to that module endomorphism. Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop identifies this section with (p followed by f).appTop(r). This proves map_smul for the additive equivalence and constructs the required linear equivalence.

proof_origin.note: Decomposition into additive natural Leray comparison and a fully proved scalar-linearity promotion. The unit route is unchanged.

theorem nonempty_linearEquiv_H_pushforward_of_higherDirectImage_vanishing
    {Y X T : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ T)
    [HasInjectiveResolutions Y.Modules] (F : Y.Modules)
    (hF : ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → IsZero ((higherDirectImage p q).obj F)) (q : ℕ) :
    letI : Module Γ(T, ⊤) (((pushforward p).obj F).H q) :=
      Module.compHom _ f.appTop.hom
    letI : Module Γ(T, ⊤) (F.H q) :=
      Module.compHom _ (p ≫ f).appTop.hom
    Nonempty (((pushforward p).obj F).H q ≃ₗ[Γ(T, ⊤)] F.H q)
